pictures.author: A.Savin
pictures.inspected: White two-storey long house with green standing-seam hip roof, six visible pale chimneys with green caps, pale foundation/base vents, southeast terrace/balcony on northeast half, triangular upper pediment, light canopy and a west-side stair/porch. Trees obscure the far eastern end. Map gives33m by12m and8m nominal height; vertical details remain approximate.

pictures.inspected: Inspected actual northwest/rear oblique photo: tall arched upper window, low polygonal projecting room with green hip roof, open wooden porch on southwest half, lattice rail panels/posts, rear green eaves and white chimney stacks. Hidden rear window and bay counts approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete Leo Tolstoy House exterior at Yasnaya Polyana: actual mapped long house, white two-storey facades, green standing-seam hip roof and six chimneys; front balcony with open rails, supported brackets, triangular pediment and plain light canopy; two physically recessed doors; rear tall arched window above a low polygonal projecting bay, and open wooden porch with supports, lattice rail proxies and treads. Hidden roof/bay inventories and historical thresholds remain approximate. No copied furnishings, inscriptions, artworks, planting or photograph pixels.
